scope: Static data-flow inspection plus all 360 LEVEL diagnostics; no refits, new arm, or new score evaluation.
finding: Grouping does not receive anchor. Wrapper uses it only for validity and orientation of weights that fit_content discards. DS and HEM latent-class orientation do not use q15_H1. Across 720 group SML fits anchor never flips the preceding sign. Across 720 MoM fits anchor orientation agrees with positive sum and positive majority; no ties. No observed anchor-specific sign effect explains LEVEL reduction results.
